anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before rejected the course model outright (mapped the numeric 2 to a `review` row, substituted `fix`, dropped course/caps/syncs as 'fields that grant nothing', refused the in-loop sync so the run stalled at a BEHIND/wait menu before readiness, never renewed the deadline on own pushes, had C's re-run happen 'outside the gate', and had no sync lease for D), so every fact failed. After delivers the Change cleanly: a single numeric 2 persists course deliver with 10/10 caps before writes, P1 and CI-minted P2 are repaired and closed without an intermediate menu, the deadline table shows 12:17 / 12:25 / 12:27 renewals on own pushes with the 12:11 BEHIND read explicitly marked as a base-only observation, BEHIND queues the loop sync and the final menu offers merge without executing it, B's exit cites the repair-wave source-change rule and dismisses the base-sync SHA move, C performs exactly one in-wave re-run then exits stuck, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases against A, and resets cleanly to B with no second push. No fact regressed. Two small hardening suggestions for the After wording: name the fresh sequential helper explicitly in the P1/P2 wave rows (f1 asks for 'fresh helpers' and the table only implies it), and in D's table state in one line that both sync heads were persisted before `git rebase` began, so the ordering claim in f6 is read directly from the record row rather than inferred from the 'persisted before the sync' usage note.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused the deliver course outright, so it satisfied none of the facts; After delivers the course model well on f1, f3, f4, f5 and f6 (single initial pick, BEHIND auto-sync, stuck exits on repeated red with base-only SHA movement rejected, exactly one re-run in C, and D's pre_head B / expected_remote_head A lease-and-restore). The one fact After still misses is f2: the 12:02 own push is recorded with poll_deadline null, justified as 'no binding pending check opens a watch window', so the 12:02→12:17 renewal the fact requires never appears in the table (12:25 and 12:27 are present and the 12:11 base-observation non-renewal is correctly distinguished). The timeout rule in the Change says the window renews on own push, not on a pending-check condition, so the After wording should set poll_deadline to 12:17 on the 12:02 push row (and say that a later CI failure consumes rather than withholds that window).
